interpretation: These are wrong-model or altered-input controls, not counterexamples to the all-genus target. Integrity controls bind to the externally pinned manifest hash. The original author also reran eight separate semantic integrity controls.
mathematical: Replacing the FS2 lattice by Z^2 wrongly predicts extension.
Failing to divide the FS1 coedge by two wrongly obstructs extension.
Discarding rather than contracting fixed edges wrongly retains an FS2 cut.
Two triangles interchanged at one fixed vertex have three edge orbits but anti-rank one; the coordinate theorem cannot be globalized.
The dual of integral anti-homology incorrectly contains each t_i/2 in FS2; the correct projected-homology dual admits their half-sum but not either alone.
A lone fixed joining node at each normalization has odd branch degree and is not a geometrically admissible cover.
The u,v,u+v,u-v union fails the parallelogram identity although each triple works.
FS4 is perfect-cone extendable despite coedge index two.
A doubled triangle is an FS2 degeneration but not a generic two-component FS cover.
An involution reversing a fixed edge or exchanging the two branches of a fixed loop is inadmissible; explicit validation rejects both.
